caption: A small red dragon sits alone. The head is rounded with two short horns pointing back from the top, a narrow snout, and two small bright eyes set on either side. A row of small triangular spines runs from the top of the head down the neck and along the back to the tail tip. The body is compact and rounded, with a chest that swells forward and a belly of slightly lighter red. Two small folded wings rest against the upper back, their thin membranes tucked close. Four short legs support the body, each ending in three small claws. The tail curves around the right side and tapers to a point. The dragon faces forward, sitting upright with its weight settled on its hind legs and its front legs planted. It is shown in three-quarter view, full body, centered in the frame and filling most of it. The whole dragon is visible with a clear margin on every side. The background is transparent. The art uses a dark outline, flat shading with a soft light from the upper left, and a palette of reds and darker reds.

request: a round brown owl on a twig
caption: A round brown owl perched on a twig. The owl has a large, spherical body covered in soft, mottled brown feathers. Its head is broad and rounded, with two prominent ear tufts pointing upward. The face features a pale, heart-shaped facial disc with two large, dark eyes and a small, curved beak. The wings are folded against its sides, showing darker brown barring. The tail is short and extends downward behind the twig. The twig is a thin, straight, dark brown branch. The owl faces forward, gripping the twig with its talons. The view is a three-quarter angle, showing the full body of the owl and the length of the twig. The owl is centered in the frame, filling most of the space. The whole subject is visible with a clear margin on every side and nothing cut off. The background is transparent. The rendering uses a dark brown outline, soft shading with a light source from the upper left, and a palette of warm browns, creams, and dark greys.

An astronaut stands facing forward, one arm raised in a wave. The helmet is a rounded white dome with a wide, dark visor across the front, reflecting a faint pale blue sheen. A thick white neck ring joins the helmet to the torso. The suit is bulky and white, with a rectangular chest control panel in pale grey set at the centre of the upper chest, and darker grey joints at the shoulders and elbows. A life-support backpack shows as a squared white block behind the shoulders, slightly wider than the torso. The legs are thick white tubes with grey knee bands, ending in heavy grey boots. The gloves are grey and segmented. The astronaut faces the viewer, right arm lifted to head height with the palm open, left arm hanging at the side, legs together and straight. The full figure is centred in the frame, seen from the front, filling most of the height with a clear margin on every side and nothing cut off. The background is transparent. A dark outline surrounds the figure, shading is flat with soft grey shadows on the suit's underside, and the palette is white, grey and dark blue.

A pirate ship, a compact wooden sailing vessel. At the top, three tall masts rise vertically, each made of brown wood with a slight taper toward the top. Square sails hang from horizontal yards on each mast, coloured off-white with faint grey shading, billowing slightly outward. Thin dark ropes run from the mast tops down to the hull edges. The hull is a long, curved wooden body, dark brown along the bottom and lighter brown above, with a raised stern at the back and a pointed bow at the front. A row of small round black portholes runs along the side of the hull. A black flag with a white skull and crossbones flies from the top of the rear mast. The ship sits level, facing left. The view is a side profile, the whole object visible with a clear margin on every side and nothing cut off. The background is transparent. The rendering uses a black outline, flat shading with hard cel steps, and a palette of browns, off-white, black, and grey.

A small friendly robot stands upright in the centre of the frame. Its head is a rounded box, light grey on the front and slightly darker on the sides, with two large round eyes set side by side, each eye a bright blue circle with a small white highlight in its upper left. A thin dark line curves below the eyes into a gentle smile. Two short antennae rise from the top of the head, each a thin dark grey rod tipped with a small round red ball. The body is a compact rectangular torso, light grey with a darker grey panel across the middle, and a small round blue button sits at the centre of the chest. Two short arms hang at the sides, each made of a thin grey upper segment and a rounded claw hand. Two short legs support the body, each ending in a flat, rounded foot. The robot faces straight forward, standing still with its arms relaxed at its sides. It is shown from the front, full body, centred in the frame and filling most of the height with a clear margin on every side. The background is transparent. Every edge carries a chunky dark outline, and the surfaces are flat shaded with lighter grey highlights on the upper left and darker grey shadows on the lower right, using a palette of greys, blue and red.

request: a sword with a flaming blade
caption: A sword with a flaming blade stands upright as the single subject. The blade rises straight up from the guard, long and tapering to a sharp point at the top. The blade's core is a bright yellow-white, running the full length of the steel, and the flames wrap around it in layered tongues of orange and red that lick upward along both edges and flare widest near the middle of the blade. The flames taper toward the tip, where a small lick of orange curls above the point. Below the blade, a straight crossguard extends horizontally to both sides, coloured dark iron-grey with squared ends. The grip is a short, narrow cylinder beneath the guard, wrapped in brown leather with faint darker bands, and the pommel at the bottom is a rounded iron knob. The sword stands vertically, point up, facing the viewer straight on. It is centred in the frame and fills most of the height, with a clear margin on every side and nothing cut off. The background is transparent. A dark outline traces the sword and the flame edges, with hard cel shading, a light source from the upper left, and a palette of yellow, orange, red, grey and brown.

A cluster of purple crystals. Several pointed crystal shards grow upward and outward from a shared base, packed tightly together. The tallest crystal stands at the centre, a long narrow spire that tapers to a sharp point at the top. To its left, a slightly shorter crystal leans outward at a small angle, and to its right another medium shard tilts the opposite way. Smaller crystals cluster around the base, filling the gaps between the larger ones with short, stubby points. Each crystal is faceted, with flat angled planes running from base to tip. The colour runs from deep violet at the bottom of each shard to a lighter lavender near the tips, with bright pale highlights along the edges where the facets meet. The cluster rests upright, facing forward. Seen from the front, the whole cluster is centred in the frame and fills most of the height, with a clear margin on every side and nothing cut off. The background is transparent. The rendering uses dark outlines, flat shading with hard cel steps, and a palette of purple, violet and pale lavender.

request: an orange cat dressed as a chef
caption: An orange cat dressed as a chef. The cat's head sits at the top, round with two triangular ears pointing upward, the outer fur a deep orange and the inner ears a lighter peach. Two round green eyes sit above a small pink nose, with a white muzzle and thin white whiskers spreading to either side. A tall white chef's hat rests on top of the head, cylindrical with a puffed top and a narrow band around the base. Below the head, a white double-breasted chef's jacket covers the chest and shoulders, with a row of small dark buttons down the front and short sleeves ending at the elbows. Two orange forearms extend from the sleeves, ending in small paws with visible toes. Below the jacket, orange legs and a long orange tail curving to the right are visible. The cat stands upright on its hind legs, facing forward. It is centred in the frame as a full-body front view, filling most of the height with clear space around it. The whole subject is visible with a clear margin on every side and nothing cut off. The background is transparent. The art uses dark brown outlines, flat shading with soft highlights on the hat and jacket, and a warm palette of orange, white, pink and green.

request: a frog sitting on a mushroom
caption: A small green frog sits on top of a red mushroom. The frog's rounded head is the widest part of its body, with two large round eyes set high on either side of the head, each a black pupil ringed by a pale yellow-green iris. A wide, flat mouth line curves gently across the lower face. The body is a compact oval of bright green, slightly narrower than the head, with a paler cream-green belly showing at the front. Two short front legs rest on the mushroom cap, and two longer hind legs fold close against the sides of the body. The mushroom has a broad, rounded red cap with a slightly domed top and a soft downward curve at its rim, dotted with several pale cream spots. A short, thick cream-white stem supports the cap, widening slightly at its base. The frog sits upright and faces straight forward, its body centred on the mushroom. The whole subject is viewed from the front in full, occupying the centre of the frame and filling most of its height with a clear margin on every side. The background is transparent. A dark green outline traces the frog and mushroom, with flat cel shading and a light source from the upper left; the palette is bright green, red, cream and dark green.

A bowl of ramen, drawn as a single standalone object. The bowl is a wide, shallow ceramic vessel with a rounded rim and a gently curving base, coloured a warm off-white with a thin dark brown band running around its upper edge. Inside the bowl, a mound of pale yellow noodles curls in loose loops, piled slightly higher at the centre. A dark brown broth fills the bowl around the noodles, its surface glossy and slightly reflective. On top of the noodles rest two slices of pale pink pork, laid flat and overlapping near the front. A halved soft-boiled egg sits to one side, its white firm and its yolk a deep golden orange. A few green scallion rings and a sheet of dark green nori stand near the back rim. The bowl faces forward, sitting upright and still. The composition is a front view, centred, filling most of the frame with a small even margin on every side. The whole subject is visible with a clear margin on every side and nothing cut off. The background is transparent. Outlines are solid dark brown, shading is flat with hard cel steps, and the palette is warm cream, brown, pink, gold and green.

A red and white lighthouse stands alone as a single compact object. At the top sits a small lantern room with a rounded red roof and a narrow dark window band beneath it. Below the lantern room runs a short railing gallery in white, edged with thin red posts. The tower body is a tall tapered cylinder, wider at the base and narrowing toward the top, its surface painted in alternating horizontal bands of bright red and clean white. The white bands are slightly wider than the red ones, and the lowest band is red where it meets the base. A small dark doorway is set into the base of the tower, facing forward. The lighthouse stands upright in a simple resting pose, facing straight toward the viewer. It is shown in a flat orthographic front view, the whole object visible from the base to the roof, centred in the frame and filling most of the height with clear margin on every side. The background is transparent. Every shape carries a thick black outline, shading is flat with a single soft highlight down the left side of the tower, and the palette is limited to bright red, white and black.

A hot air balloon floats as a single rounded object. The envelope is a large teardrop shape, widest near the top and tapering to a narrow neck at the bottom, built from vertical panels that alternate between deep red and pale cream. A small dark opening sits at the very bottom of the envelope, where the panels gather inward. Thin dark cords run down from the rim of that opening, four of them visible, angling slightly outward as they descend. The cords meet the corners of a small square basket, which is woven from light brown wicker with a darker brown rim along its top edge. The basket hangs level below the envelope, small in proportion to the balloon above it. The balloon is shown from a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the left, with the envelope upright and the basket hanging straight down. It is centred in the frame and fills most of the height, the whole object visible with a clear margin on every side and nothing cut off. The background is transparent. A dark outline defines the envelope, cords and basket, the shading is flat with a soft lighter band on the left side of the envelope, and the palette uses reds, creams, browns and dark outlines.

request: a black cat wearing a wizard hat
caption: A black cat wearing a wizard hat sits upright. The wizard hat rests on top of the head, tall and pointed, deep blue with a wide brim circling the skull and a lighter blue band around the base of the cone. The hat's tip leans slightly to one side. Beneath the brim, two pointed black ears stick out at the sides of the head. The face is black with two round yellow-green eyes set wide apart, a small triangular nose, and a thin mouth. Whiskers are not visible. The body is black and rounded, with a smooth back and a chest that narrows toward the front. Four black legs are tucked neatly beneath the body, the front paws close together and the hind legs folded at the sides. A long black tail curls around the right side of the body, its tip resting near the front paws. The cat faces forward, sitting calmly. It is shown in full body from a front three-quarter view, centred in the frame and filling most of it. The whole cat is visible with a clear margin on every side and nothing cut off. The background is transparent. Dark outlines edge every shape, with soft shading lit from the upper left, in a palette of blacks, deep blues and yellow-green.

request: a potted cactus with a pink flower
caption: A potted cactus with a pink flower. The cactus is a short, rounded barrel shape, wider at the base and slightly narrower toward the top, with a soft green body and a few faint vertical ridges running up its sides. Small pale spines dot the ridges in even rows. At the very top of the cactus sits a single pink flower, its petals opening outward in a shallow cup around a small lighter center. The flower is small compared with the body of the cactus. The cactus grows from a terracotta pot with a wide rim and sides that taper down to a flat base, the pot a warm orange-brown with a slightly darker band near the top. The plant sits upright, facing the viewer. The view is front, full body, with the whole pot and cactus centered in the frame and filling most of its height. The whole subject is visible with a clear margin on every side and nothing cut off. The background is transparent. The art uses a dark outline, flat shading with a light source from the upper left, and a palette of greens, terracotta browns, and pink.

request: a desert oasis with palm trees
caption: A desert oasis with palm trees. The oasis is a small pool of clear blue water at the center of the scene, its surface smooth and still. Around the water, a ring of sandy ground in warm tan and pale gold tones. Several palm trees stand along the edges of the pool, their slender brown trunks rising straight up, each topped with a cluster of long green fronds that arch outward and droop at the tips. The fronds are bright green with darker green shadows between them. The water reflects the sky above in a lighter blue band across its middle. The pool sits level, facing forward. The composition is a wide view filling the frame edge to edge, with the oasis centered and the pool and palms taking up most of the space. The background is open desert: pale sand dunes stretching to the horizon under a clear light blue sky. The rendering uses dark outlines, flat shading with hard cel steps, and a palette of blues, greens, tans, and browns.

request: an underwater coral reef with fish
caption: An underwater coral reef with fish fills the scene. Branching coral rises from the lower left in pale pink and orange, its tips rounded and clustered. A large fan coral spreads across the centre in deep purple, its surface ribbed with fine lines. Boulder coral sits at the lower right in grey-green, its surface bumpy and rounded. Small orange fish swim in a loose group above the branching coral, their bodies slender and their tails forked. A yellow fish with a tall dorsal fin drifts near the fan coral, facing left. A blue fish with a rounded body hovers near the boulder coral, facing right. The reef faces forward, its corals resting on the sea floor. The view is a front-facing scene that fills the frame edge to edge, with the reef occupying the lower two-thirds and the fish scattered through the upper half. The background is clear blue water that fills the whole frame, with faint light rays slanting down from above. Rendering uses soft shading with dark outlines, gentle highlights along the coral edges, and a palette of pink, orange, purple, green, yellow, blue and grey.

A city skyline at night stands as a row of tall buildings against a dark sky. The tallest building rises at the centre, a narrow rectangular tower of dark blue-grey with rows of small yellow windows stacked evenly up its face. To its left stands a shorter blocky building of deep charcoal grey, its windows lit in pale amber. To its right a second tower rises slightly lower than the centre one, its surface a muted slate blue with scattered white-yellow window lights. Between them sit lower buildings, flat-topped and dark, their windows glowing faint orange. The buildings face the viewer straight on, resting in a still upright pose. The skyline fills the frame edge to edge, the towers occupying the lower two thirds and the sky the upper third. Behind and above the buildings the night sky spreads in flat dark navy blue with a few small white stars. Outlines are black, shading is flat with hard-edged window highlights, and the palette is dominated by deep blues, charcoal greys and warm yellow window lights.

A mountain lake at sunrise fills the frame. A pale yellow sun sits low on the horizon at the upper right, a bright disc with a soft orange glow around it. Above it the sky runs from deep blue at the top edge through purple and pink to warm orange near the horizon. A row of jagged mountain peaks stretches across the middle of the frame, dark blue-grey rock with lighter grey faces catching the first light on their right sides and snow caps on the highest summits. Below the peaks a band of dark green pine forest runs along the far shore. The lake occupies the lower half of the frame, its surface flat and calm, reflecting the orange and pink of the sky and the dark silhouettes of the mountains. The reflection is broken by a few thin horizontal ripples in lighter blue. The view is straight on, the shoreline level across the middle, the sun and its reflection aligned vertically at the right. The rendering uses soft shading with warm highlights from the right and a palette of orange, pink, purple, blue and dark green.

A cozy bedroom at night. A wide bed sits low in the room, its mattress covered by a thick quilt in warm rust and cream, with a folded blanket of deep maroon lying across the foot. Two plump pillows rest at the head, pale cream with soft grey shading in their creases. A dark wooden headboard rises behind them, its grain marked by lighter brown lines. To the left of the bed stands a small wooden nightstand with a single drawer and a round knob. On top of it, a small lamp glows with a warm yellow shade over a dark base. A rectangular window sits high on the back wall, showing a deep navy night sky with a scatter of tiny pale stars. The floor is bare dark brown wood with faint plank lines. The bed faces forward, still and neatly made. The view is a straight-on front view, the room filling the frame edge to edge, the bed centred and taking up most of the lower half. The background is the plain wall in muted blue-grey behind the furniture. Rendering uses soft shading, dark outlines and a warm palette of browns, rust and cream against cool blue night tones.

request: a space station orbiting a planet
caption: A space station orbiting a planet. The station is a long central spine of pale grey metal running diagonally from the lower left toward the upper right. At the middle of the spine sits a wide cylindrical hub, light grey with darker grey banding rings around it. From the hub, four thin trusses extend outward, each ending in a flat rectangular solar panel: two panels above the spine and two below, all dark blue with thin lighter blue grid lines across their faces. At the upper right end of the spine is a small cluster of modules, a boxy white command section with a tiny black window strip, and a short antenna mast with a small dish at the tip. At the lower left end, a narrow engine block with a dark grey nozzle. The station floats at a slight tilt, facing the viewer at a three-quarter angle. It sits centred, filling most of the frame. Below and behind it, a large curved planet fills the lower two-thirds of the frame, its surface banded in blue oceans and pale green-brown landmasses with soft white cloud swirls. Above the planet's curved horizon, the black of space fills the top of the frame with scattered small white stars. Rendering uses flat shading with soft ramps, thin dark outlines, light from the upper left giving pale highlights along the spine and panels, in a palette of greys, dark blue, white, blue and green.

An erupting volcano at dusk. The mountain rises in a broad cone, its slopes made of dark grey and brown rock with rough, uneven ridges running down its sides. Near the summit the rock gives way to a glowing crater, filled with bright orange and yellow molten rock that spills over the rim. A thick column of smoke rises from the crater, dark grey at its base and fading to lighter grey and brown as it climbs. Streams of lava run down the upper slopes in branching orange lines, cooling to dull red and black near the bottom. The volcano stands centred and faces forward, its peak near the upper middle of the frame. The view is a wide frontal scene that fills the frame edge to edge. The background is a dusk sky in bands of deep blue, purple and warm orange near the horizon, with the smoke column blending into the darker upper sky. The rendering uses dark outlines, flat shading with hard cel steps, and a palette of dark greys and browns against glowing oranges and dusky blues.
